title: Page Structure
story: Use tags that say what a part IS: header, nav, main, footer. Screen readers and search engines understand them.
goal: Wrap the page parts: put the title in a header, the links in a nav, the text in main and the credit in a footer.

tests.label: A header contains the h1
tests.js: return !!$("header h1") || "h1 is not inside a header"

tests.label: A nav contains the links
tests.js: return $$("nav a").length >= 2 || "links are not inside a nav"

tests.label: main contains the welcome paragraph
tests.js: return /welcome/i.test(txt("main p")) || "paragraph is not inside main"

tests.label: A footer contains the credit
tests.js: return /made with care/i.test(txt("footer")) || "credit is not inside a footer"

hints: The h1 goes inside header, the two links inside nav.
